clue.text: Swing the lead, though perfectly healthy

definitions.meaning: on a ship, swinging the lead line means measuring the depth of water
in good condition, as in a fit body or a solid structure

explanation.surface: Someone is accused of shirking while being in fine health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swing the lead' is British slang for faking illness to dodge work, which pulls against the health sense; here it is read literally as taking a depth reading with a weighted line.
explanation.definitionFit: To take a depth measurement at sea is to plumb the water; healthy and whole people are described as fit in wind and limb.

clue.text: Transport can be arranged as here

indicators.note: letters that can be arranged differently are being rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone observes that transport can be organised from this very spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A funeral vehicle is a form of conveyance for a coffin.

clue.text: Put wise about top money in the end

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for wise goes around the other pieces

parts.note: a wise person is a sage
taken as written
P stands for penny or pence, a unit of money

explanation.surface: An instruction to tell someone the facts about top pay at the finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put wise' looks like the slang phrase for informing someone, but 'Put' and 'in' are link words and 'wise' alone gives SAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A halt or cessation of work brings things to a finish.

clue.text: Made a bed deeper

parts.note: reads as making up a softer bed, but the bed is a river or harbour floor scooped out by a machine

explanation.definitionFit: Clearing silt from a riverbed with a scoop increases the depth of the channel.

clue.text: To put a value on a paper is tricky

indicators.note: something tricky is awkward and twisty, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Valuing a document is said to be a difficult job.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess or estimate the worth of something is to put a price on it.

clue.text: Wrapping up well, the body not getting any younger!

parts.note: a pack is a body or group of people or animals
growing older is ageing, here spelt without the middle E

explanation.surface: Someone well wrapped against the cold, with a body that is showing its years.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well' is padding in the surface; the body is a group, not a physical frame.
explanation.definitionFit: Materials that enclose a product, such as boxes and film, cover it up for sale.

clue.text: The tale of a couple finding nothing's right

parts.note: love means nothing in tennis scoring, plus the S of the possessive
a Tory is a right-winger, a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A pair discover that nothing is going their way.
explanation.definitionFit: A romance is a narrative about two people falling for each other.

clue.text: Communicate point after point

indicators.note: after means the first point is placed behind the second one

parts.note: S is the compass point south
a peak is a pointed summit

explanation.surface: Someone makes their case one argument after another.
explanation.definitionFit: To talk or utter words is a way of conveying a message.

clue.text: One consumes a little because required to do so

indicators.note: only a little of the words is used, a short run found inside them

explanation.surface: Someone eats a small amount because they have been told they must.
explanation.definitionFit: A consumer is someone who takes up or employs something, a customer.

clue.text: What may be printed about one being heroic

indicators.note: about means the rearranged word goes around the letter for one
what the word may be once its letters are reordered signals a rearrangement

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A question about what newspapers might print concerning a hero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What may be' turns PRINTED into INTREPD, which goes 'about' I.
explanation.definitionFit: A fearless, bold person is brave in the way a hero is.

clue.text: Caress the person setting the rate

definitions.meaning: to touch gently with the hand
in a rowing eight, the oarsman nearest the stern sets the pace for the crew

explanation.surface: An instruction to fondle whoever is setting the pace.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentle pat or sweep of the hand; and the rower who sets the beat for the boat.

clue.text: Headed by a Spartan queen

parts.note: to have headed a group is to have led it

explanation.surface: A queen of Sparta leads the way.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth she was wife of King Tyndareus of Sparta and was visited by Zeus as a swan.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth she was a queen of Sparta, the mother of Helen.

clue.text: They depend on a man occasionally, more often a woman

definitions.text: They depend on a man occasionally, more often a woman

parts.words: They depend on a man occasionally, more often a woman
parts.note: depend is used in its old sense of hang down, so these items dangle from a person's lobes

explanation.definitionFit: Jewellery worn on the lobes hangs from the head, more often on women than men.

clue.text: The chief executive parking and staying

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs
someone staying in a place lives there

explanation.surface: The boss parks and stays put.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of state in a republic such as the US holds executive power.

clue.text: A coach for rough terrain

indicators.note: rough suggests the letters are roughed up and disordered

explanation.surface: A bus or sports tutor suited to rugged country.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who instructs athletes or teams is a sports coach.

clue.text: No sailor likes great cold lumps in the main!

definitions.text: No sailor likes great cold lumps in the main!

parts.words: No sailor likes great cold lumps in the main!
parts.note: the main is the sea, and the lumps are frozen masses floating in it that endanger ships

explanation.definitionFit: Huge floating masses of frozen water are a peril to shipping.

clue.text: The underworld presume on backing

parts.note: to presume is to infer or conclude

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the word on is reversed

explanation.surface: Hell is assumed to be about betting on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Hell is often pictured as a blazing furnace, the realm of the damned.

clue.text: Ran up a charge-five hundred-as told

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: taken as written
a charge or fee is a rate
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: Someone ran up a bill of five hundred, as they related.
explanation.definitionFit: Recounted or related, as a story is.

clue.text: An instructor can bring out a diver's potential

indicators.note: the potential of the letters is what they could become when rearranged

explanation.surface: A coach can help a diver realise their ability.
explanation.definitionFit: A counsellor or guide gives instruction and recommendations.

clue.text: Trade's bad all round the South-east, so it's claimed

indicators.note: all round means the jumbled letters surround the abbreviation
bad suggests the letters are spoilt and mixed up

parts.note: SE is the abbreviation for south-east

explanation.surface: Business is said to be poor everywhere in the south-east of England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' turns TRADES into ASRTED, which goes 'all round' SE.
explanation.definitionFit: Stated firmly as a fact; maintained.

clue.text: Raising it with Her Majesty could result in a row

indicators.note: in a down clue raising lifts the word, so it is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: ER is the royal cipher, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: Bringing something up with the Queen might cause a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' tempts as a quarrel; it is a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A level or rank of seats in a stadium is a line of them.

clue.text: Rush about pursued by a top journalist

indicators.note: pursued by means the first piece is followed by the second

parts.note: re means about or concerning
ED is short for editor, the senior journalist

explanation.surface: Someone dashes around, chased by a senior reporter.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulrush is a tall waterside plant of the grass family, much like a cane.

clue.text: English country property

parts.note: a state is a nation or country

explanation.surface: A rural property in England.
explanation.definitionFit: Landed holdings, or all of a person's possessions, are their assets.

clue.text: A poet carrying some weight

definitions.meaning: Ezra, the American modernist who wrote the Cantos
an imperial unit of weight of sixteen ounces

explanation.surface: A heavy poet, or one carrying a load.
explanation.definitionFit: Ezra of that surname wrote modernist verse; a unit of mass equal to 16 ounces.

clue.text: Hold on if there's a dunderhead present

parts.note: the head of dunder, its first letter
present means in this place

explanation.surface: Stay put if a fool is around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dunderhead' is read as dunder's head, its first letter, not as a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: To stick fast or cling to something is to keep hold.

clue.text: Currently popular case for doing nothing whatsoever

parts.note: in means fashionable at the moment
a case in law is an action or lawsuit

explanation.surface: A trendy lawsuit that achieves nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Idleness or lack of activity is the absence of any effort.

clue.text: Taking a horse on board can cause problems

indicators.note: taking means the ship letters take in the horse

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, the thing one is on board
a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: Loading a horse onto a vessel can lead to difficulties.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitches or unexpected difficulties hold things up.

clue.text: Choosing to give voice about the chosen

indicators.note: about means the word for give voice goes around the word for chosen

parts.note: to give voice is to sing
the elect are those chosen

explanation.surface: Picking someone to speak up for the favoured few.
explanation.definitionFit: Picking or opting for one from several is making a pick.
